notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
Llanowar Loamspeaker does not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Llanowar Loamspeaker's second ability by tapping it, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
